import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { lingerEnabled } from '../src/os/probe.js';
test('acceptance: the engine keeps running after its user logs out (linger)', () => {
  const linger = lingerEnabled();
  if (linger === null) return; // no login manager here (a container)
  assert.equal(linger, true);
});
